The page stays within its assigned scope across all four subsections without encroaching on adjacent chapters. Prose is readable and non-repetitive. All cited URLs match supplied research source URLs or the permitted internal site path. An FAQ section appears and is correctly assigned in the plan. Workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, and exceptions are present and consistent across all subsections. Illustrative examples are clearly labeled hypothetical.
